source: Generated by canon-docs from website/status.yaml; each status is read from the AEP story it names

items.label: Typed catalog assertions
items.detail: canon-expr/1 parsing, type checking, recipes, exact numbers, acquisition planning and pure replay over typed observations; available in source release 0.1.0.

items.label: protocol/1 source model and parser
items.detail: Artifacts, evidence kinds, claims, obligations, actions, outcomes and invalidation rules, read strictly; unknown keys and explicit nulls are refused.

items.label: Deterministic validation
items.detail: Format, identifiers, duplicates, unresolved references and claim cycles, in a stable order.

items.label: canon-ir/1 compilation
items.detail: Canonical ordering, explicit defaults, one serialization suitable for hashing.

items.label: ESS specification of the data model
items.detail: The model is specified under ess/ and held to a hard gate; a test fails when the two differ.

items.label: Three-valued claim evaluation
items.detail: canon evaluate over a case snapshot and an evidence directory, writing a canon-decision/1 document; scenario CANON-CLAIM-001, also covering CANON-CLAIM-002.

items.label: Evaluation documents
items.detail: canon-case/1, canon-evidence/1, canon-authority/1, canon-decisions/1 and canon-decision/1, and the canon-properties/1 document canon check reads.

items.label: canon conform run
items.detail: Runs canon-conformance/1 scenarios that compile a fixture and evaluate a case, with authority decisions, explicit decisions and an evaluation instant when a step gives them.

items.label: Normative conformance suite
items.detail: The canon-requirements/1 catalogue lists the CANON-* requirements Canon implements; canon conform run --requirements fails when an implemented one has no passing scenario, a scenario covers one the catalogue omits, or an evaluate step gives another decision when rerun or with its evidence, authority and decisions reversed.

items.label: Evidence bound to revisions
items.detail: Evidence applies only to the current revision of the artifact it names; a record bound to another revision is listed as excluded under each claim that reaches its kind, and one about an undeclared artifact is refused; scenario CANON-EVIDENCE-001.

items.label: Subject-bound evidence matches
items.detail: An evidence match may name the artifact its record must be about; a record about another artifact does not match it; scenario CANON-EVIDENCE-003.

items.label: Evidence freshness
items.detail: Evidence older than its kind's max_age at the --at instant is excluded, so a match it alone decided is UNKNOWN rather than FALSE; scenario CANON-EVIDENCE-002.

items.label: Invalidation rules
items.detail: A rule names an upstream artifact and the claims its revision change invalidates; evidence observed against an earlier revision no longer supports them, and claims built on them follow their predicates; scenario CANON-INVALIDATION-001.

items.label: Obligations
items.detail: Each obligation is open or discharged by its discharge predicate; scenario CANON-OBLIGATION-001.

items.label: Action admissibility
items.detail: Admissible, approval-required or blocked, from preconditions and authority decisions; scenario CANON-AUTHORITY-001.

items.label: Outcomes
items.detail: Legitimate or blocked; no completion through an undeclared or blocked outcome; scenario CANON-OUTCOME-001.

items.label: Decision-based outcomes
items.detail: An outcome may require an explicit decision taken at the current case revision; scenario CANON-OUTCOME-002.

items.label: Structured explanation
items.detail: Every decision says what it was computed from and why each value is what it is, down to the evidence records that applied or were excluded; scenario CANON-EXPLAIN-001, also covering CANON-DETERMINISM-001.

items.label: canon check
items.detail: Every state of a protocol's finite state space; unreachable outcomes, unsatisfiable preconditions, unproduced evidence, authority bypasses with a witness state, and failing properties with a counterexample.

items.label: canon generate
items.detail: One minimal witness scenario per outcome and per blocked action, which canon conform run runs unchanged.

items.label: Semantic diff
items.detail: Classify a protocol change as tightening, relaxation, breaking, expansion or no semantic change.

items.label: Case inputs and applicable obligations
items.detail: A protocol declares case inputs with closed value lists; the input predicate and applicable_when let one compiled protocol serve several profiles; scenario CANON-INPUT-001.

items.label: Evidence from an independent producer
items.detail: An evidence match demands that its records' producer be independent on declared dimensions, which the case resolves for each producer; a record that fails the demand leaves the match UNKNOWN, never FALSE; scenario CANON-INDEPENDENCE-001.

items.label: Action argument schemas
items.detail: An action declares one argument schema in Canon's JSON Schema 2020-12 dialect, which a runner reads and validates calls against; absent, the action takes only {}. canon validate refuses a schema outside the dialect, canon compile carries it unchanged into canon-ir/1 and canon diff classifies its changes.

items.label: Cases compose at run time
items.detail: Child cases and their outcomes as evidence; Atlas ADR 0081.

items.label: Protocols express step order
items.detail: A predicate over evidence order, the first record of a kind and one kind before another; Atlas ADR 0084.

items.label: A record observed after the first of a kind
items.detail: The after order form tests whether a record of one kind with a given result was observed strictly after the first record of another kind, or of the same kind, read from the evidence history like first and before; scenario CANON-ORDER-002.

items.label: Order within a second
items.detail: An observed_at may carry a fraction of one to nine digits, and first, before and after compare every instant of one evaluation at the coarsest precision written among its records, so records within one second are ordered when all are written finer and equal instants are not; expiry keeps whole seconds; scenario CANON-ORDER-003.

items.label: A record observed since the latest of a kind
items.detail: The since order form tests whether a record of one kind with a given result, at the subject revision of the latest record of another kind (or of the same kind), was observed after it, read from the evidence history like the other order forms; scenario CANON-ORDER-004.
